Oneliner

Demonstrate X-band communication and reflectarray system compatible with the NASA Near-Earth Network.
Description

Demonstrate a high rate communication system that is compatible with the NASA Near-Earth Network. It will utilize a CU-developed X-band communication system and a 1m deployable reflectarray antenna from MMA Design.

Test a novel Deployable High Gain Reflectarray (DaHGR)4 antenna which will employ a 1 m2 reflectarray. The secondary goal is to mature and demonstrate a 200kbps S-band uplink that includes Code Division Multiple Access (CDMA) capabilities. This mission will raise the TRL of the XTx radio, S-band receiver and T-DaHGR antenna to TRL 9.
